correctness.rationale: Three-eigenspace decomposition and SRG restricted-eigenvalue identities yield both orbit formulas exactly, with positive denominator; all nonedge entries positive; the edge sign is a single quadratic, giving global necessity, sufficiency, and nonreentry. Scalar Padé numerator (z-3)^2+3 and denominator positivity give positive definite diagonals and unconditional Euclidean stability. Independently constructed direct rational matrices matched 5,580 entries over 11 graphs.

evidence: Gottlieb–Shu–Tadmor (2001), Sec. 6, develops implicit strong-stability-preserving restrictions, not endpoint positivity on all strongly regular Laplacians.
Gottlieb–Gottlieb (2003), Sec. 2, studies linear-operator strong stability for Runge–Kutta methods.

Zappavigna–Colaneri–Kirkland–Shorten (2012), Sec. 4, gives sufficient positivity hypotheses for Padé discretizations and global counterexamples, rather than a necessary-and-sufficient sharp strongly regular threshold.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General SSP/absolute-monotonicity bounds concern all monotone systems and need not imply a sharp structured-operator endpoint threshold; the Padé counterexamples do not settle the symmetric, three-eigenvalue class.

The eight-state Markov record studies the same rational map on a non-symmetric pure-birth generator; its full Result establishes a minimal dimension and a nonmonotone positivity window, not strongly regular graph diffusion.

originality.rationale: No covering result found in actual published-finding corpus searches across exact method, Padé aliases, equivalent graph classes, parameter algebra and generic implicit positivity. Full primary texts and closest published mathematical result were read and compared by implication. Earlier complete multipartite and explicit RK4 results cover subfamily/different scalar map, not the new general theorem; specialized unindexed prior work remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: Literature searches and source inspections are not proof of priority; exact same result might appear under association schemes, distance-regular graphs, Padé functional calculus or positivity of Markov discretizations.
Prior complete multipartite special cases are excluded from any novelty assertion independent of the whole all-strongly-regular classification.

value.rationale: A sharp natural invariant and complete structured family: one parameter expression classifies all-step positivity and gives a sharp scalar threshold for primitive and imprimitive strongly regular diffusion networks. It identifies which transitions fail while spectral stability remains unconditional, a directly useful accuracy/safety distinction, not a fixed-parameter exercise.
